subproblem.title: Uniform lower mass bound at support points near x (Simon 6.3(1)) from Lᵖ monotonicity, density and Θ ≥ 1
subproblem.statement: Assume the contract Props LpMonotonicity (Simon 4.5–4.8 with the corrected κ = (p−n)/(4p)), LpDensity (4.9) and LpSupportRepresentation (4.10(1)). Let n ≥ 1 and ℓ ≥ 0 be integers, V a rectifiable n-varifold in ℝ^{n+ℓ} with weight μ = μ_V, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open, H a generalized mean curvature of V in U (HasMeanCurvatureIn U H), θ ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e. in U (MultiplicityGE 1 U), p > n real with H ∈ L^p_loc(μ_V) in U (IsLocallyLp U H p), and x ∈ U. Then there is ρ₀ > 0 such that μ.real(B_s(ζ)) ≥ (ω_n/2)·sⁿ for every ζ ∈ spt V ∩ B_{ρ₀}(x) and every s ∈ (0, ρ₀]. Here B_s(ζ) is the closed ball, ω_n = omega n, spt V = V.support and μ.real(A) = (μ(A)).toReal.
subproblem.lean_statement: LpMonotonicity → LpDensity → LpSupportRepresentation → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (p : ℝ) (x : Ambient n ℓ), 0 < n → IsOpen U → V.HasMeanCurvatureIn U H → V.MultiplicityGE 1 U → (n : ℝ) < p → V.IsLocallyLp U H p → x ∈ U → ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ∀ ζ ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall x ρ₀, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ₀ → omega n / 2 * s ^ n ≤ V.weight.real (closedBall ζ s)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Conventions. μ := V.weight (= μ_V); B_s(ζ) := closedBall ζ s (closed ball); μ.real(A) := (μ A).toReal; ω := ω_n = omega n; for s > 0, a_ζ(s) := μ.real(B_s(ζ))/sⁿ; Θ(ζ) := V.density ζ; κ := lpKappa n p = (p − n)/(4p); e := 1 − n/p; spt V = V.support. Source: Simon 6.3, printed (1). It follows from 4.7–4.8 with σ ↓ 0 (contract Prop LpMonotonicity), 4.9 (LpDensity) and 4.10(1) (LpSupportRepresentation), exactly as in step 1 of the supplied proof of 6.3.

1. Constants. Since 1 ≤ n < p, we have p > 0, κ > 0 and e > 0 (because n/p < 1). Also ω > 0. Indeed, ω is the toReal of the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n). That ball is nonempty and open, so its measure is positive (measure_ball_pos). It is also bounded, so its measure is finite (measure_ball_lt_top). Hence ω ∈ (0, ∞).

2. Choice of R. Since U is open and x ∈ U, there is r > 0 with ball(x, r) ⊆ U. Put R := r/4 > 0. Then B_{2R}(x) = closedBall(x, r/2) ⊆ ball(x, r) ⊆ U.

3. One Λ for all centres near x. K := B_{2R}(x) is compact and K ⊆ U, so IsLocallyLp U H p gives MemLp H (ENNReal.ofReal p) (μ.restrict K). Since ENNReal.ofReal p ≠ 0, ENNReal.ofReal p ≠ ∞ and its toReal is p, the function y ↦ ‖H y‖^p is integrable on K (MemLp.integrable_norm_rpow), and it is ≥ 0. Put:
- I₀ := ∫_{B_{2R}(x)} ‖H‖^p dμ ≥ 0;
- A₀ := (R^{p−n}·I₀)^{1/p} ≥ 0;
- Λ := A₀/κ ≥ 0, so that κΛ = A₀;
- C := (e^{Λ/2}/2)·Λ ≥ 0.
Let ζ ∈ B_R(x). For y ∈ B_R(ζ), |y − x| ≤ |y − ζ| + |ζ − x| ≤ 2R, so B_R(ζ) ⊆ B_{2R}(x) ⊆ U. Since ‖H‖^p ≥ 0 is integrable on B_{2R}(x), the set integral is monotone in the set (setIntegral_mono_set): 0 ≤ I_ζ := ∫_{B_R(ζ)} ‖H‖^p dμ ≤ I₀. Since R^{p−n} ≥ 0 and u ↦ u^{1/p} is nondecreasing on [0, ∞), we get (R^{p−n}·I_ζ)^{1/p} ≤ (R^{p−n}·I₀)^{1/p} = A₀ = κΛ.

4. Applying LpMonotonicity. For ζ ∈ B_R(x), all hypotheses of LpMonotonicity hold with centre ξ := ζ, radius R and constant Λ: 0 < n, U open, HasMeanCurvatureIn U H, n < p, IsLocallyLp U H p, 0 < R, B_R(ζ) ⊆ U, and the bound of step 3. It yields F = F_ζ : ℝ → ℝ such that, with t(s) := (s/R)^e, the following hold for all s ∈ (0, R]:
(i) e^{−(Λ/2)t(s)} ≤ F(s) ≤ e^{(Λ/2)t(s)};
(ii) |F(s) − 1| ≤ C·t(s);
(iii) Ψ(s) := F(s)·a_ζ(s) + (F(s) − 1) is monotone (nondecreasing) on (0, R].
The function G and the identity 4.7 are not used.

5. Limits at a support point. Suppose in addition ζ ∈ spt V. Then ζ ∈ spt V ∩ U, because B_R(x) ⊆ U. The first conjunct of LpDensity gives V.HasDensityAt ζ Θ(ζ), i.e. μ.real(B_s(ζ))/(ω·sⁿ) → Θ(ζ) as s ↓ 0. The first conjunct of LpSupportRepresentation (whose hypotheses include MultiplicityGE 1 U) gives Θ(ζ) ≥ 1.
(a) For s > 0, a_ζ(s) = ω·(μ.real(B_s(ζ))/(ω·sⁿ)), since ω ≠ 0. Hence a_ζ(s) → ωΘ(ζ) as s ↓ 0.
(b) The map s ↦ (s/R)^e is continuous at 0 with value 0^e = 0 (as e > 0), so C·t(s) → 0 as s ↓ 0. Since (ii) holds on (0, R], which contains a right-neighbourhood of 0, squeezing gives |F(s) − 1| → 0, i.e. F(s) → 1 as s ↓ 0.
(c) Hence Ψ(s) → 1·ωΘ(ζ) + (1 − 1) = ωΘ(ζ) as s ↓ 0.

6. Lower bound for F·a. Keep ζ ∈ spt V ∩ B_R(x) and fix s ∈ (0, R]. For every s' ∈ (0, s), (iii) gives Ψ(s') ≤ Ψ(s), since s' and s both lie in (0, R] and s' ≤ s. The interval (0, s) is a right-neighbourhood of 0, so letting s' ↓ 0 in step 5(c) gives ωΘ(ζ) ≤ Ψ(s) (limits preserve non-strict inequalities). Since Θ(ζ) ≥ 1 and ω > 0, ω ≤ ωΘ(ζ) ≤ Ψ(s). Therefore, by (ii),
F(s)·a_ζ(s) ≥ ω − (F(s) − 1) ≥ ω − |F(s) − 1| ≥ ω − C·t(s).

7. Choice of t₀ and ρ₀. Let t₀ := min{1, ω/(4(C + 1)), log(3/2)/(Λ/2 + 1)}. All three entries are positive, so 0 < t₀ ≤ 1.
- Since C ≥ 0, C·t₀ ≤ C·ω/(4(C + 1)) ≤ ω/4.
- Since Λ ≥ 0 and log(3/2) > 0, (Λ/2)·t₀ ≤ (Λ/2)·log(3/2)/(Λ/2 + 1) ≤ log(3/2). Hence e^{(Λ/2)t₀} ≤ e^{log(3/2)} = 3/2.
Put ρ₀ := R·t₀^{1/e}. This equals R·t₀^{p/(p−n)}, since 1/e = p/(p − n) > 0. Then ρ₀ > 0, and ρ₀ ≤ R because 0 < t₀ ≤ 1 gives t₀^{1/e} ≤ 1. For 0 < s ≤ ρ₀ we have 0 < s/R ≤ t₀^{1/e}. Since u ↦ u^e is nondecreasing on [0, ∞) and (t₀^{1/e})^e = t₀^{(1/e)·e} = t₀ (as t₀ ≥ 0), we get t(s) = (s/R)^e ≤ t₀.

8. Conclusion. Let ζ ∈ spt V ∩ B_{ρ₀}(x) and 0 < s ≤ ρ₀. As ρ₀ ≤ R, ζ ∈ spt V ∩ B_R(x) and s ∈ (0, R], so steps 4–6 apply; t(s) ≤ t₀ by step 7.
- By step 6 and C ≥ 0: F(s)·a_ζ(s) ≥ ω − C·t(s) ≥ ω − C·t₀ ≥ ω − ω/4 = (3/4)ω > 0.
- By (i), Λ ≥ 0 and t(s) ≤ t₀: 0 < e^{−(Λ/2)t(s)} ≤ F(s) ≤ e^{(Λ/2)t(s)} ≤ e^{(Λ/2)t₀} ≤ 3/2.
From F(s) > 0 and F(s)·a_ζ(s) > 0 we get a_ζ(s) > 0. Hence (3/4)ω ≤ F(s)·a_ζ(s) ≤ (3/2)·a_ζ(s), i.e. a_ζ(s) ≥ ω/2. Multiplying by sⁿ > 0 gives μ.real(B_s(ζ)) = a_ζ(s)·sⁿ ≥ (ω/2)·sⁿ, i.e. omega n / 2 * s ^ n ≤ V.weight.real (closedBall ζ s). As ζ and s were arbitrary, ρ₀ has the required property. ∎
proof_key_steps: ω_n > 0, κ = (p−n)/(4p) > 0 and e = 1 − n/p > 0; choose R > 0 with B_{2R}(x) ⊆ U

One Λ := (R^{p−n}∫_{B_{2R}(x)}‖H‖^p dμ)^{1/p}/κ bounds the Lᵖ quantity at every centre ζ ∈ B_R(x) (Lᵖ integrability from IsLocallyLp and set-integral monotonicity); apply LpMonotonicity at (ζ, R, Λ) to get F with exponential bounds, |F − 1| ≤ C t(s) and Ψ = F a + F − 1 monotone on (0, R]
At ζ ∈ spt V ∩ B_R(x), LpDensity gives a_ζ(s) → ω_nΘ(ζ), LpSupportRepresentation gives Θ(ζ) ≥ 1, and F(s) → 1, so Ψ(s) → ω_nΘ(ζ)
Monotonicity of Ψ gives Ψ(s) ≥ ω_nΘ(ζ) ≥ ω_n, hence F(s)a_ζ(s) ≥ ω_n − C t(s)
Choose t₀ ∈ (0,1] with C t₀ ≤ ω_n/4 and e^{(Λ/2)t₀} ≤ 3/2, and ρ₀ := R t₀^{p/(p−n)} ≤ R, so that t(s) ≤ t₀ for 0 < s ≤ ρ₀
F a ≥ (3/4)ω_n and 0 < F ≤ 3/2 give a_ζ(s) ≥ ω_n/2, i.e. μ.real(B_s(ζ)) ≥ (ω_n/2)sⁿ
